description: Build an MVP spike for a first-class local codex_cli provider in ReqLlmNext. Keep auth external, prefer local Codex CLI login or API-key login outside the package, add the narrowest viable text/object execution path, and document the support boundary and risks for a spike branch that may not be kept.
